title: 📊 Daily Report: Wed Nov 4, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $18,497.46. For the week it's down $102.35 against Monday's base: the strategies are down $49.28 and the CORE QQQ position is down $53.07. Since the merge the book is down 7.61% ($1,523.28), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 1.51% ($302.43), so we're trailing by $1,220.85.

No bots traded today. The gate was open, but no setup met the entry rules. Rota and Sunny are the active bots, Trek has no edge, and the rest are benched. There are 4 open positions. CORE QQQ is on with the trend filter (prior close 685.28 vs the 200-day at 679.01). It holds $15,048, which is 81% of the book. Idle cash earned $0.24 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- Democrats took both chambers and stocks ripped: S&P +1.6%, Nasdaq +1.4%, Dow +3% (+1,575). Hospitals, discount retailers and big cash-rich tech led; data-center and AI-infrastructure names fell on regulation fears.
- Oil crashed about 8.7% (Brent ~$94.60) on bets the Iran war ends sooner, so energy lagged (CVX -3.9%). We're putting the whole energy group back in avoid; our open XOM/CVX longs took a hit.
- Our open ideas did well: MMM +9.7% and MSFT +7.1% led the Dow. Both are now hold only, no adding.
- Our gap rule paid again: AMD was +7% before the open but closed just +1%, and DDOG fell 14% on a flat guide.
- After hours: AppLovin jumped about 14% on a beat, while Qualcomm (-4%, soft outlook) and MercadoLibre (-8%) slipped. Next: claims Thu, ABNB and NET Thu night, October jobs Fri.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/
